evidence.detail: All existing achievements (TournamentWinner, PerfectRun, FlawlessRun, etc.) are per-player metrics; none track per-card firsts
TournamentWinner counts wins per player but has no card-level tracking; a per-card 'first winner' achievement would require a fundamentally different data structure

triage.notes: A per-card 'first tournament win' achievement differs structurally from all existing achievements: it needs a per-card lookup table, a preaggregation query joining deck_card to tournament results, and possibly a migration. Scope is medium-large.
